slots.node01.label: Corporate controllers
slots.node01.title: Review earlier
slots.node02.text: Controllers move from a single review on day nine to rolling review from day one. They see exceptions, not every entry, and sign off on day five.
slots.node03.text: Time shifts from checking entries to judging exceptions.
slots.node04.label: Entity accountants
slots.node04.title: Reconcile as you go
slots.node05.text: Accountants reconcile balance-sheet accounts during the month with one template. Exceptions go to an owner the same day, with the evidence attached.
slots.node06.text: Month-end becomes a review of work already done.
slots.node07.label: Shared services
slots.node07.title: Automate the matching
slots.node08.text: The shared-service team runs intercompany matching overnight and clears breaks each morning, replacing email threads across eleven entities.
slots.node09.text: Fewer breaks reach the controller at all.
slots.title: Three groups change how they work
